cdsfee.title: Northwestern Common Data Set 2025-2026 (C13 application fee)

test_policy.notes: Test-optional for first-year applicants; SAT/ACT not required. Admitted students who submitted scores must send official scores before matriculation.

requirements.notes: App fee $75 is from the CDS (C13). One counselor and one teacher recommendation. No alumni interviews; applicants from international high schools may submit an optional InitialView interview. Applicants needing aid file the CSS Profile or ISAFA (international).

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding)
deadlines.notes: Decision in December 2026 (no exact date published).

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decision in March 2027 (no exact date published).

deadlines.label: CSS Profile or ISAFA (ED, international)
deadlines.notes: Request aid consideration by Nov 1; tax forms due Dec 5.

deadlines.label: CSS Profile or ISAFA (RD, international)
deadlines.notes: Request aid consideration by Jan 2; tax forms due Feb 5. The general admissions page lists Feb 1 for RD aid.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if your first/primary language is not English or your secondary schooling was not in English. Scores cannot be self-reported (must be sent officially). No minimum score is published; competitive applicants score in the high range on all sections.

english.notes: No minimum published. TOEFL ITP Plus for China and MyBest scores are not accepted; no superscoring.
No minimum published. IELTS Indicator accepted.

aid.notes: International admission review is need-aware (a request for aid and the amount needed may factor into the decision). Northwestern meets 100% of demonstrated need.

tier_notes.business: No undergraduate business major (Kellogg certificate only).
tier_notes.engineering: McCormick is a top-15 engineering school.
tier_notes.pre_med: Strong pre-med outcomes; Feinberg School of Medicine and the HPME program.
tier_notes.arts_design: School of Communication (theatre, radio/TV/film) and Bienen School of Music are among the best in the US.
